name: Line level paging microphone
subtitle: Max. 1 per system; Use for general paging
legacyName: Line level paging microphone (max. 1 per system)- Use for general paging
summary: The 1ZDM is a Line Level Paging Microphone for the AVAC voice evacuation system of Context Plus, one 1ZDM Microphone can be used per System. The 1ZDM has been designed to offer a microphone for AVAC voice alarm systems for public address paging. The Console comprises a sturdy ABS case c/w a high-quality flexible gooseneck microphone, a speak-bar (push-to-talk button), an LED output level meter and two status indicators (OK and Fault). To page, the microphone’s speak-bar is pressed.
description: The speak-bar will be lit solid green and speaking may commence. This Line Level Paging Microphone model 1ZDM may be used as an Fireman’s Emergency Microphone (instead of the VA405) provided it is located in a secure position where it cannot be tampered with.
